Start date: 1004-07-23  
40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 282 days.  

1004 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
From 07-23:  
Days in July remaining: 8 (23 to 31 inclusive: 31-23=8)  
August: 31 → total 39  
September: 30 → 69  
October: 31 → 100  
November: 30 → 130  
December: 31 → 161 (end of 1004)  

282 - 161 = 121 days into 1005.  
January 1005: 31 → 31  
February 1005: 28 (1005 not leap) → 59  
March: 31 → 90  
April: 30 → 120  
121st day is May 1, 1005 (since 120 days brings to April 30).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-05-01
